message.content: To evaluate the SIGN dimension for robustness trade-off studies in equivariant networks, verify that empirical scope extends beyond simple benchmarks (e.g., MNIST) to complex datasets to ensure domain impact (SIGN-DOM) and generalizability. Confirm the paper proposes novel methods or practical mitigation strategies rather than solely diagnostic observations, thereby demonstrating improvement over state-of-the-art (SIGN-SOT) and real-world applicability (SIGN-IMP).
